name: Python
short_description: Clean modern Python programming from syntax fundamentals to OOP and algorithms.
description: Complete Python programming curriculum spanning dynamic typing, scoping, data structures, object-oriented design, functional features, context managers, and core libraries.

courses.title: Python Programming
courses.description: Comprehensive journey from foundational syntax to object-oriented programming and standard libraries.

modules.title: Fundamentals
modules.description: Python interpreter model, dynamic typing, primitive types, and operators.

topics.title: Python Variables & Data Types
topics.summary: Dynamic references, integers, floats, booleans, and mutability distinctions.

topics.title: Type Casting & Operators
topics.summary: Implicit vs explicit casting, arithmetic and boolean operators.

modules.title: Control Flow
modules.description: Conditionals, truthy/falsy evaluation, for and while iteration.

topics.title: Conditional Branching & Loops
topics.summary: If-elif-else statements, while loops, for loops with range, break and continue.

modules.title: Functions
modules.description: Function definitions, parameter binding (*args, **kwargs), closures, and lambda.

topics.title: Defining Functions & Scope Resolution
topics.summary: Def syntax, default arguments, LEGB scope rules, and first-class functions.

modules.title: Iterators, Generators & Decorators
modules.description: Lazy iteration and functions that build or wrap other functions.

topics.title: Iterators & Generators
topics.summary: The iteration protocol, generator functions, and lazy pipelines.

topics.title: Closures & Decorators
topics.summary: Functions that capture state and functions that wrap other functions.

modules.title: Collections
modules.description: Lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, and comprehension expressions.

topics.title: Lists, Dictionaries & Comprehensions
topics.summary: List slicing, dict hash tables, set operations, and list/dict comprehensions.

topics.title: Tuples, Sets & Choosing a Collection
topics.summary: Immutable tuples, set algebra, hashability, and picking the right container.

modules.title: Strings
modules.description: String formatting (f-strings), slicing, and common methods.

topics.title: String Formatting & Methods
topics.summary: F-strings, split/join methods, and immutable byte representations.

modules.title: OOP
modules.description: Classes, instance variables, dunder methods, inheritance, and encapsulation.

topics.title: Classes, Inheritance & Polymorphism
topics.summary: __init__, self convention, super(), method overriding, and duck typing.

modules.title: Exception Handling
modules.description: Try, except, else, finally blocks and custom exception hierarchies.

topics.title: Try-Except Blocks & Custom Exceptions
topics.summary: Handling built-in errors and raising domain-specific exceptions.

modules.title: Files
modules.description: File modes, context managers (with statement), JSON serialization.

topics.title: File I/O & Context Managers
topics.summary: Open modes, auto-closing resources, and JSON loading/dumping.

modules.title: Modules & Packages
modules.description: Import system, __name__ == '__main__', packages, and virtual environments.

topics.title: Module System & Package Imports
topics.summary: Import mechanics, sys.path resolution, and package structuring.

topics.title: Standard Library Essentials
topics.summary: collections, itertools, math, datetime, pathlib, and json in everyday programs.

modules.title: Testing & Debugging
modules.description: Checking that code works and finding out why it does not.

topics.title: Unit Testing & Debugging
topics.summary: Writing tests with unittest and pytest, assertions, and systematic debugging.

modules.title: Basic Algorithms
modules.description: Standard Python algorithmic patterns, bisect, collections.Counter, and sorting keys.

topics.title: Algorithmic Patterns in Python
topics.summary: Custom sort keys, defaultdict, Counter, and deque idioms.
